That all lines up with what we agreed — I can see each part I care about has its own chunk of work: the paste-and-pull-in-details capture, the searching, the read-later queue, my notes, and the editing and bulk actions. And I like that each one has its own way to check it works on its own.

Go ahead and begin building. I'll be looking to see it actually working when it's ready.
